messages:
Jordan Lee: hey folks :wave: I'm Jordan (infra eng), started Monday. Quick doc ask — who's the go-to for the following so I can add them to my week-1 checklist: model onboarding, runtime infra (deploys + perf tuning), access provisioning, and production incident escalation?

Priya Gupta: welcome Jordan! :tada: For access provisioning, ping me or open a ticket in #help with subject 'Access - new hire'. People Ops handles org-level grants (okta/GCP).

Maya Patel: hi Jordan — model onboarding and runtime config lives with Eng Platform. For model onboarding requests use @eng-ml + /forms/model-onboard. If you need dedicated capacity config, that's also Platform (me).

Samir Ortiz: for prod incidents + escalation path: Eng-SRE owns the oncall. Short matrix:
```
Incident severity 1 -> page eng-sre-oncall (5m) -> if no ack escalate to Samir (15m) -> then Eng-Platform lead
Access/security incidents -> page sec-oncall
```
Also see runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/incident-escalation (internal).

Devon Ramos: adding: for model quality/regression reviews reach out to Eng-ML. We pair with Platform for rollouts (canary/A-B). If you plan to onboard a new open model, ping me and I'll schedule a short vet session.

Jordan Lee: thanks all — super helpful. Quick follow-up: is there a single ownership roster (who owns what) or should I paste this into my notes?

Maya Patel: there's a lightweight ownership roster in the handbook but it's a bit stale. I'll drop a small table below and follow up with a PR to update the handbook.

Maya Patel: ```
owners:
  access: Priya Gupta (People Ops) / #help
  runtime infra: Maya Patel (Eng-Platform)
  model onboarding: Devon Ramos (Eng-ML) + Eng-Platform
  production incidents: Eng-SRE oncall -> Samir Ortiz
  security incidents: Security Team
```

eng-oncall-bot: Oncall reminder: eng-sre-oncall currently: @Samir Ortiz (primary), @Kelsey (secondary). Page policy: 5/15/30 escalation.

Jordan Lee: perfect — I'll add these to my notes and tag you if I hit any roadblocks. Appreciate the quick answers! :pray:
